item.title: Why Our 1970s Parents Had It So Much Better Than We Do
item.description: When I look back on my own 1970s parents and childhood, I can't help but think that today's parents—and kids—are getting a raw deal.

item.title: Don’t Be the ‘Excellent Wife’ Your Husband Doesn’t Want
item.description: I've been married 5 years, and I'm not exactly the Proverbs 31 wife. But I am trying every day to be the kind of wife my husband actually wants.

item.title: I Decided I Was the Worst Parent on the Planet, Then I Said This to My Daughter
item.description: My impatience with my child led me to beat myself up as a parent. And then, a talk with my daughter made me realize what the problem REALLY was.

item.title: A Letter to You, Mom, From Your Exasperating Strong-Willed Child
item.description: This letter from your grown-up strong willed child, Mama? Proves it's all SO worth it.

item.title: 20 Martin Luther King Jr. Quotes For Living Your Best Life Today
item.description: Whether you want to learn more about history, justice, or faith, these powerful Martin Luther King Jr. quotes keep his leadership, legacy, and faith alive.

item.title: The Reality of Losing A Parent at A Young Age
item.description: You don’t have a time limit on your grief, my friend. Take this process for as long as you need. This is the reality of losing a parent at a young age.

item.title: I Was Trying to Teach Kids Generosity, But I Wasn’t Ready for This
item.description: Friends, I know we mess up as parents. In our house, we mess up a lot, if I'm being totally honest. But I know we got this right. Generosity doesn't have to cost much, but it can make a huge difference.

item.title: Why I Don’t Do Elf on the Shelf (and I’m Not Even Kinda Sorry)
item.description: This mom has some pretty great reasons for keeping the elf off her shelf. How do YOU feel about the little guy?

item.title: Talking to My Kids About “Tricky People” — Not Just “Strangers” — Saved Their Lives
item.description: Teaching my kids about "tricky people" saved their lives last week. Here's how to give your kids this much-needed talk!
